criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name the DOA, the capability, and the correction signal within the LinkedIn 'see more' window; concrete and non-snarky.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: RFI 02-107-26 is a real procurement document affecting vendor bid strategies; consequence named with specificity (PFD, licensing, unemployment, DOA budget/liability risk).

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: 'So the read is reasonable' paragraph fairly grants the claim-holders' logic before rebutting; no snark, generously framed.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: NASCIO primary source strong; second pillar (RFI-vs-RFP + DOA no-comment) is credible secondary via GovTech, both in dossier, but no state-level deployment data beyond NASCIO framing.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Dates, RFI number, report title, outlet names, and service names (PFD/licensing/unemployment) appear throughout; a few connective sentences are vaguer.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attributed to named primary (Alaska DOA, RFI 02-107-26); counter-evidence uses one primary (NASCIO) and one credible secondary (GovTech); RFI PDF machine-unreadable but verbatim confirmed via GovTech per dossier validation note.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking throughout; bullet list and 'Here's where it breaks' framing match post_001 cadence; no banned phrases detected; no LinkedIn-influencer drift.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 424 words, 2778 chars, 2-4 sentence paragraphs, one 3-item bullet block; fully within all mechanical bounds.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Binary question ('bid the vision or bid the proven floor') is real, debatable, and directly tied to the corrected frame for the integrator audience.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Program managers and bid teams can name a concrete decision to reframe: reassess timeline and liability assumptions in any Alaska agentic-AI bid strategy built on this RFI.

one_sentence_fix: Add one concrete data point (e.g., a named state that attempted and paused an agentic government service deployment, or a specific NASCIO governance gap metric) to give the rebuttal a second primary-source pillar beyond the NASCIO framing language.
